page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet with the e-rara logo at top right, then a centred title block, then two blocks of licence text separated by rules, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. Logos, the e-rara.ch and Persistent Link block, the licence and terms-of-use texts, and the Visual Library mark are the digitiser's own matter and are left out. Only the book's own title and imprint appear here and are not transcribed as text.
